in_marathi.name: Maanasa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mind, Thought, Sensation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maanasa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘manas’ (mind) and ‘asana’ (seat), Maanasa signifies the seat of thoughts, emotions, and sensations. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a river in the Himalayas, believed to be the abode of Lord Shiva.
